description:
[read-only] How every flayr voice (chat voice, voiceovers, character VO) says a brand's words: `pronunciations` (term → sayAs respelling, with `verified` when a Verify passed), `suggested` (learned suggestions, inert until accepted) and `builtIn` entries. Captions and transcripts keep the written word. `brandId` from list_brands, or `personal`.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/pronunciations.)

brandId.description: Brand id, or `personal`. Default: a bound key's brand, else your active brand.

name: pronunciations_list
title: List pronunciations
